description: Rose confirms Blondie's car lead and gives the plate note.

nodes.speaker: rose
nodes.text: You are wearing detective on your face again. That usually means somebody else had a worse night.

options.text: What do people leave this block in?

nodes.speaker: rose
nodes.text: Yeah. Blondie. She got into a car instead of walking. I wrote the plate before the neon swallowed it.

nodes.speaker: rose
nodes.text: Depends who is chasing who. Tonight? A car mattered more than the street did.

conditionalFollowups.speaker: rose
conditionalFollowups.text: You have the plate note. Match it to a real car before the handwriting stops mattering.
